storage-benchmark-build.description: Build the release CLI and reference storage benchmark with two jobs, without a release test harness

benchmark-build.description: Build release binaries, examples, and benchmarks with two jobs

lint.description: Run Clippy on all Rust targets

test.description: Run the Rust tests that changes since the last passing run can affect (every target after a library or build change), explicit library/binary/integration roots, or one supported resource/reuse test module file; four build jobs and four test executables at once

harness-test.description: Run Node harness tests or explicit existing tools/*.test.mjs files with two workers and report skipped tests; HARNESS_REQUIRE_COMPILERS=1 fails on skips

semantic.description: Check fixtures/references against the pinned TypeScript 7.0.2 semantic oracle and fixtures/navigation against its document symbols; exit 2 means the compilers were not found

native-corpus-journeys.description: Build the release CLI and compare eight frozen Command Center corpus journeys twice per path, recording CLI peak RSS and samples from one service generation

native-corpus-load-baseline.description: Measure two direct and two service lexical requests on the source-bound release corpus binary, including normal checker initialization but no member/type demand
